functions.name: Logical.From
functions.signature: Logical.From(value as any) as nullable logical
functions.summary: Creates a logical from the given value.

functions.name: Logical.FromText
functions.signature: Logical.FromText(text as nullable text) as nullable logical
functions.summary: Creates a logical value from the text values "true" and "false".

functions.name: Logical.ToText
functions.signature: Logical.ToText(logicalValue as nullable logical) as nullable text
functions.summary: Returns the text "true" or "false" given a logical value.
